perks.name: Subsistence

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.desc: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.desc: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Classy Contender
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant class ability energy.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6 (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for Minor add clearing in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Triple Laureate is a spread shot hand cannon, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being a huge statistical outlier but a little niche and close-range. The frame intrinsic fires 12 pellets with a max 25m range, after which they disappear as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. It's difficult to make direct comparisons with the D2Foundary website down but hopefully when it's back https://d2foundry.gg/w/1605599021 will show how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. With the constrained range, focus on Handling with the barrel perk to make it snappier, or maybe a little extra stability. With the magazine perk, focus on extra shots or faster reload. For end-game use, for reloads, in the first trait perk column Slideshot refills 15% (rounded up) of the mag when you slide, and boosts both Range and Stability by +20 (+22 when enhanced) for 2.5s or on the first shot fired. If you're willing to get closer, Grave Robber refills your magazine on an elemental melee hit or any melee kill. In the second column, for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or recoving damage within a 5s window for at least 12s (11.5s enhanced) - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration. There's the choice of Classy Contender origin trait which provides 5% (6% enhanced) Class ability energy on kills, which is useful if not game-changing, or Hakke Breach Armaments passively boosts damage against vehicles by ×1.15 (×1.2 enhanced), turrets and constructs by ×1.3 (×1.6 enhanced) and Stasis crystals by ×1.45. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
